package.name: uav_swarm_nodes
package.description: Shared utility ROS2 nodes for the BFT UAV swarm validation testbed (Phase 0 item 7). MVP scope: - position_broadcaster_node: publishes NoisyPose at a configurable rate with sigma noise injected on top of a (synthetic or externally-provided) ground-truth position. - uwb_ranging_simulator_node: publishes pairwise range measurements with sigma_range = 0.1 m Gaussian noise. - comm_logger_node: logs subscribed-topic byte sizes and send rates (feeds Phase 0 item 10 comm-complexity check).
